stat_guide_body: HP (+5 per point) Max health. Shield: your HP points build a shield at the start of every battle, absorbed before HP (up to 50% of max HP, reduced by armor pierce). Layers: more HP points add extra shield layers, blue, then dark blue, orange, violet, red. Each layer is a full pool and breaks one after another. No limit past the World Gate. Lifesteal and Absorb fill HP first, then top up the layer you are on. ATK (+1 per point) Attack damage per hit. Combo: ATK points give extra-hit chance (up to 3 extra hits). Combo tiers multiply every extra hit, like a critical. DEF (+1 per point) Directly reduces incoming damage (at least 15% gets through). Block: DEF points give a chance to halve a hit (max 20%). Reflect: every block also strikes the monster for a share of its max HP, multiplied per reflect tier. Guard: putting most of your points into DEF unlocks Guard tiers past the World Gate. Each tier cuts every hit you take by 10%, compounding, no limit. AGI (+1 per point) Crit: AGI×0.15% Crit Dmg: 1.5× + AGI×0.075% (max 4×) Dodge: AGI×0.035% (max 20%) Crit chance above 100% becomes crit tiers, each tier multiplies again (max 5). LUC (+1 per point) Gold: LUC×0.1% Drop Rate: → +0.8% (10K LUC) → +1.7% (1M LUC) → +3% (1B LUC) How it adds up Shield, Combo, Block, Reflect and Guard scale with the points you allocate, not with gear, and are reduced by monster resistance. Concentrating your points in one stat earns extra tiers for that stat; spreading them evenly earns none. Every all-in build is measured to land within 25% of a balanced one. Tap the chart button in battle to see your real numbers against the current enemy.
